decisions.reason: Sunk costs in the black-finish line and the need to justify the 2023 launch still outweigh the limited website mention, so management persists.
Substantial development costs for the pump-assisted solution and public commitment keep withdrawal unlikely despite only an online mention.
The dedicated page and core fit create high visible commitment, making the tileable floor drain very unlikely to be dropped.
As a central design-led product with its own page, dropping it would contradict the firm's announced direction, so it is kept.
The own page and the fact that it launched only in 2024 let weak results be attributed to temporary conditions, so the pump-drain channel is retained.
